Seti Astro Suite Pro

V2.0.1
Quick Stack now runs on any GPU SASpro's hardware acceleration installs (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, DirectML and Apple Silicon) and no longer needs the CUDA Toolkit on NVIDIA. The Stacking Suite fits a laptop screen, about 90 tools have a Reset button, the menu bar is shorter, the Start Panel can be customized, SASpro's own panels follow your theme, SyQon Studio before 1.2 is supported, and Windows builds are signed. Full release notes: https://github.com/setiastro/setiastrosuitepro/releases
